info.name: Pixel Jukebox API
info.description: REST control surface of the Pixel Jukebox firmware. Set the `device_ip` collection variable to the board's IP address or to `pixel-jukebox.local`. Full contract: docs/jukebox-api.md.

variable.description: The board's IP address or hostname, no scheme or port (e.g. 192.168.4.105 or pixel-jukebox.local).
A postId from List Saved Art, for the requests on one saved artwork.
The panel's PIN, if one is set. Sent in the X-Jukebox-Pin header of every request.

request.description: Current slot, hold state, the artwork on screen, brightness and device information.
Memory and task-stack headroom since startup, and why the board last restarted.
Returns the device name and the API base path.
The last crash or watchdog reset, if one is stored: task, cause, addresses and backtrace. tools/decode_crash.py turns the addresses into function names.
The raw crash record, for espcoredump.py. 404 when there is none.
Erases the stored crash record.
Skips to the next slot. Also releases a hold. Queued: read Get Status to see the result.
Holds the current slot on screen.
Releases a held slot.
With no body, switches between held and released.
The current mode, the chosen visualizer and the visualizers available.
Shows the current visualizer until the mode changes.
Switches to sound mode with spectrum bars.
Switches to sound mode with the VU meter.
Switches to sound mode with the oscilloscope.
Switches to sound mode with fire.
Returns to the rotation (Makapix artwork and clock).
Reads the brightness (0-255).
Sets the brightness (0-255). Saved on the board.
The night schedule's settings, and whether it is night now.
Dims the art to 8 from 22:00 to 07:00, fading over 10 minutes.
Shows only the clock at night. Other settings stay as they are.
Turns the panel off at night; Next wakes it for an hour or until morning.
Turns the schedule off.
Whether photo mode is on, and the refresh rate.
Redraws about five times as often, so cameras film the panel without dark bands. Saved; the board restarts to switch.
Back to the most accurate colours. Saved; the board restarts to switch.
The rotation and the slot types available.
Three artworks, then the clock for 10 seconds. Saved on the board; starts after the current slot finishes.
Artwork only, no clock.
Three artworks and the clock, with the clock paused: it keeps its place and turns but is skipped. At least one slot must stay on.
Two featured artworks, one tagged #cat, one by @Fab, then the clock. Channels: all, promoted, mine, artist:<name>, hashtag:<tag>, likedby:<name> (your own name for your likes).
The transition used between slots, and the effects available.
A different effect each time a slot changes. The default.
Slots change instantly.
Always uses one effect. Any name from Get Transition works here.
The artworks liked from this panel, most recent first, and how many changes are still to send.
Puts a heart on the artwork on Makapix, as the panel's owner. Sent in the background; 409 until the panel is linked to an account.
Takes the heart off again.
Whether views are reported to Makapix, and how many have been sent or are waiting.
Reports each artwork shown to Makapix. The default.
Stops reporting views, and drops any still waiting.
The microSD card and the offline artwork cache on it.
The artworks saved on the card, the most recently played first. Paged with offset and limit (up to 60); see the API document.
The GIF of one saved artwork. Set the post_id variable to a postId from List Saved Art.
Shows one saved artwork on the panel now; the rotation then carries on. 409 in sound mode.
Deletes one artwork from the card.
Deletes every artwork saved on the card. Art is saved again as it plays online.
Restarts the board. The card is only looked for at start-up, so do this after inserting one.
Restarts the board into its setup hotspot (network name Pixel-Jukebox). The board goes offline; it rejoins the saved network after three minutes if nobody connects.
Expects 400; the brightness is left unchanged.
Expects 400; held must be a JSON boolean.
Expects 400; the rotation is left unchanged.
Expects 400; at least one slot must stay on.
Expects 400; the rotation is left unchanged.
Expects 404.
Expects 400; the schedule is left unchanged.
Expects 400; nothing changes and the board does not restart.
Expects 404; nothing is shown.
Expects 400; reporting is left as it was.
Expects 400; the mode is left unchanged.
Expects 400; the transition is left unchanged.
Whether a PIN is set, whether this client is signed in, and any lockout. Always open.
Signs in with the `pin` variable; Postman keeps the session cookie for the requests after it. With no PIN set it answers 200 and sets nothing.
Ends this client's session.
As written, removes the PIN (it needs the `pin` variable to be the current one). Put 4 to 8 digits in `pin` of the body to set or change it instead. Signs every browser out.
